- The ability to articulate thoughts more clearly and effectively in English.

pro_course_detail.description:

This is a great chance to do a practice interview with a native English speaker with management and hiring experience and get feedback before you interview with a company.

I'll start by reviewing your CV and the job description of the company you are applying for.

I'll work with you to ensure you have strong answers as well as examples from your past experience to help you answer the most common interview questions.  

I'll make sure that you're comfortable explaining your answers in English and that you are delivering them in a clear and concise manner.

I'll also coach you on proper interviewing etiquette, including before, during and after the interview. My goal is to make sure you feel comfortable and confident before your interview.  

I was a hiring manager for three years and have interviewed hundreds of potential candidates in the past, so I know what types of questions companies and hiring managers like to ask and how to best answer these questions.

We can also discuss salary negotiations and job expectations.

You will feel more confident and prepared for your interview after this session.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation & Accent Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the Pronunciation & Accent Training ESL English program! As an experienced language instructor, I am dedicated to helping you develop clear and confident English pronunciation, and to refine your accent to effectively communicate in any English-speaking setting.
In this specialized course, we will focus on several key areas to enhance your pronunciation and accent:
Phonetics & Sounds: We will explore the different sounds present in the English language, paying particular attention to those that may not exist in your native language. Through interactive exercises and drills, you will learn to produce these sounds accurately.
Word Stress & Intonation: Understanding word stress and intonation patterns is essential for natural and expressive speech. You will master the rhythm and melody of English, making your speech more engaging and easy to understand.
Vowel & Consonant Sounds: We will dive deep into English vowel and consonant sounds, addressing common challenges and helping you articulate them with precision.
Reduced Speech & Linking: English speakers often link words together and use reduced speech in everyday conversation. You will learn these techniques to sound more like a native speaker and improve your listening comprehension.
Accents & Regional Variations: While achieving a neutral accent is the primary goal, we also embrace and appreciate various English accents and regional variations. You will gain exposure to different accents, helping you adapt to diverse English-speaking environments.
Remember, perfect pronunciation is not the goal. Our aim is to help you communicate clearly and confidently, embracing your unique voice while developing a solid foundation in English pronunciation!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Daily Life - Practical English
pro_course_detail.description:
“English for Daily Life” is about the vocabulary necessary in order to live in a foreign country, so the class is perfect for people who live in a foreign country or who are planning to move. I have lived in three different countries, so I know you will definitely need to be familiar with these topics.

We learn things like:
* Going to the doctor
* Calling the police
* Calling an ambulance
* Going to the dentist
* Going to the post office
* Going to the vet
* Buying something at the grocery store
* Calling the government
* Calling the immigration department
* Filling out forms and paperwork
* Insurance vocabulary
* Rental contracts
* Sending a letter
* Introducing yourself to your neighbors
* Many more!

Before class I will send you a list of topics and you can choose the ones you want to learn. I will send topic-related vocabulary and we will practice the vocabulary and dialogues during class together.  

If you want a class similar to those you took in school (with a focus on vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and other skills) please schedule GENERAL ENGLISH. In General English classes, we learn topics like describing food, talking about hobbies, going on vacation, etc. "English for Daily Life" is about living and communicating when you live abroad.

pro_course_detail.title: General English: Speaking, Listening, Grammar, Writing - Intermediate to Advanced students
pro_course_detail.description:
All components of general English (speaking, listening, writing, grammar, and vocabulary) are in this course! General English lessons are traditional and have structured activities. First we learn something, then practice what we learned, and end class with a conversation or role play activity to practice what you learned. These classes are for level B1 and above. I cannot teach beginners now.

In each class, we:
1. Learn grammar rules, vocabulary, pronunciation, and listening. 
2. Do activities to practice what we've learned. (Fill in the blank, complete the sentence, match the dialogue with a response, put vocabulary in a category, etc.)
3. Do a role play or have a conversation to use what we learned earlier and speak naturally.

Lessons teach all aspects of language, including grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary, conversational English, reading, and writing skills. 

We use the following materials:
* Textbooks (I have textbooks or the student can bring their own)
* Powerpoint presentations
* Websites
* News articles and stories.

Classes are best for teenage and adult students, but I can teach children.

*Cancellation policy: Lesson cannot be canceled or rescheduled within 24 hours of class time. Money will not be refunded.*

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you hate making English mistakes at work? Do you want to ask questions but don't know how? Are telephone calls awful? Do you need to negotiate, talk to a boss, make small talk, attend a conference, write emails, etc.? Does using English at work make you nervous?

If you answer "yes" to any of these questions, you are not alone! Most English language learners are scared to make mistakes in front of people, especially at work. 

In my Business English class, I prepare students to speak in a variety of business situations, such as: 
* Meetings 
* Negotiations
* Presentations
* Small talk
* Business dinners
* Daily office communication
* Emails
* Talking to the boss
* Telephone and conference calls
* much more!!! 

You will learn vocabulary, useful phrases, and communication skills necessary for working in English.

In each class, we do the following:

* Learn vocabulary, grammar, and useful information
* Complete activities to practice using what we learned
* Have a conversation or role-play activity to use what you learned in a natural way

pro_course_detail.title: Test Preparation - IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo English Test DET
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need help preparing for IELTS, TOEFL, or the Duolingo English Test (DET)? In this Test Prep class we practice the exam in order to build confidence with answering difficult questions in an exam setting. 

We primarily work on speaking skills, such as vocabulary building and grammar. For speaking, we focus on fluency and confidence building and answer questions similar to those on the test. We go over how to make a good answer and how to make sure topics transition smoothly from one point to the next. 

Writing practice is typically assigned as homework and is checked during class. We will look at essay structure, transitioning, paragraphs, and vocabulary. There is an offline writing service available too. See below for information.
--

OFFLINE WRITING SERVICE!
I will proofread and edit your responses to practice IELTS, TOEFL, or DET questions. Book an hour lesson and I will send you your writing prompts. Then you send me your answer and I will check it for spelling, grammar, word choice, and provide advice on what you've done well and what you should improve. The writing service is offline, which means we do not meet together for class. You send me your writing and I send you a corrected document.
--

Please note that this is an OFFLINE class. There is no video meeting component to this class. Before the class start time you will send me a file containing your writing. Before the end of the class time I will return back to you a corrected version of your writing with feedback.

Submit to me any piece of writing you need grammar corrections done for and I can provide edits and feedback. Writing corrections are charged based on length of time spent editing since writing done by more advanced students is quicker to correct than writing done by beginner students. You can submit writing of any topic for revisions.

If time allows, after I am done with providing your writing corrections, I will also provide you some additional information, insight, and/or additional grammar exercises regarding any of the grammar points that you may have found difficult. 

VERY IMPORTANT:
You MUST send your writing to be corrected at or before the beginning of the class start time. I will send to you the completed writing corrections at the class end time. 

Refunds will not be provided for late writing submissions or class cancellations less than 24 hours in advance since the time cannot be reserved by other students (the usual italki cancellation policy applies).

If you do not submit writing to me for this class, I will be available during the class time for informal conversation practice in English.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I discovered teaching when I was 23 years old and I've been doing it for more than ten years.  I've taught in Asia, the Middle East, America, and Europe.  I'm in love with the process of giving myself fully to the student and to the world. I've won many teaching awards including Teacher of the Year in an American high school and I've been featured in many training videos around the world. Students love how lively I am in the classroom.  My passion is contagious and it creates an electric and dynamic atmosphere. I believe that we should train the mind to go further and learning a new language is a great way to do this.  I know how to get results while making the learning experience memorable.
teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are communicative, student-centered, interactive, fun, creative, engaging, and relevant to the student.  After more than ten years as a teacher, in-person and online, I know I can get the results that students are aiming for.  The first step is identifying the student's proficiency level.  After that, I look at the learner's strengths and weaknesses, as well as his/her learning style.  Once we have that, we discuss the reasons the student is learning.  Once we are done with this, we set out a plan and a course of action that will provide results.  Many students get to a comfortable level and stop growing.  I have developed strategies that will always push the student to the limit.

exp_info.description: I taught general English to middle and high school students in an after school language academy.  I also taught two business English lessons every day to employees of multinational companies, including the nuclear power plant Mohovce.

For this teaching assignment, I focused on teaching children.  I mostly taught elementary school children but also a few middle school children.  I improved my skills as an "edutainer" and was able to create engaging, fun, and relevant lessons for my students.

I conducted lessons to university-level students in Saudi Arabia who were considering studying abroad in English-speaking countries.  The focus was highly technical as students would be required to take entrance exams as well as language proficiency exams in English. I was very successful in preparing my students for the IELTS exam.  
Because of my professionalism I was also chosen by the university to administer the official IELTS exam at the university.

I founded this nonprofit corporation and I conducted English lessons to immigrants and refugees in order to help them integrate into American society.  The focus was practical language as my students' needs were based on survival.

exp_info.company: International Language Center of San Antonio
exp_info.description: I taught English, Spanish, and French lessons to students of various backgrounds.  From private lessons with CEOs and government officials to group lessons for children, I excelled in providing an excellent teaching service which filled the needs of the students and got them the results they were aiming for.

I started teaching on Cambly when I was doing a volunteer project in Peru.  I was assessing the English language program of a school which was serving impoverished children.  Since I wasn't making any money, I decided to teach online and make some money this way.  I've kept a few great students that I enjoy teaching on a regular basis.  This experience helped me adapt my teaching style to the virtual world.

From 2017 to 2018, I taught French and headed the French department at O'Connor High School in Texas.  There were more than 4,000 students and 250 teachers at the school.  I taught all levels and chaired the French club, which was a school organization which had the mission of immersing students in French culture outside of school.  
I won the Teacher of the Year award for my school as well as the Foreign Language Teacher of the district.

For the past year, I have been conducting lessons, seminars, and workshops to professionals in the Prague business community.  I currently hold contracts with institutions in imports/exports, information technology, commercial real estate, publishing, law, energy, marketing, medicine, orchestral music, science, engineering, and consulting.  
I also conduct teacher training seminars for local Czech teachers who are teaching English in Czech public schools.  
I've been recognized for my efforts.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English (Upper Intermediate/Advanced: B2-C1)
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the Business English course tailored for professionals seeking to enhance their language skills in the workplace. 
Crafted for B2-C1 level students proficient in basic English, this course focuses on providing specialized vocabulary and communication strategies essential for success in various work-related contexts. Delving into topics such as meetings, negotiation, sales, recruitment, leadership, marketing, finance, accounting, and time management, participants will acquire the linguistic tools needed for effective communication in a professional setting. 
With a track record of proven results, this course is designed to empower you with the language proficiency required to excel in your job. Join me on this transformative journey towards workplace fluency and heightened career success.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate General English (B1-B2) (everyday topics, daily expressions) American and British English
pro_course_detail.description: Explore your favorite subjects in our course, centering around themes like travel, food, friends, family, nature, and work. While we cover all fundamental skills—speaking, listening, reading, and writing—our emphasis leans slightly away from writing. Leveraging award-winning educational resources from National Geographic, this course is tailored for B1-B2 level students. Uncover the nuances of both American and British expressions that extend beyond conventional classroom teachings. Engage with relevant and captivating topics that breathe life into language learning, making the process both enjoyable and beneficial. Join me to master practical language skills within the context of subjects you love.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner/Elementary French (A1-A2): Quick, Easy, and Fun!
pro_course_detail.description: This program will get you speaking French faster than any other program out there. I have developed this method where we focus on the most useful and practical language and expressions first. The most important part of the language learning journey is the beginning and this will give you the perfect base. This course if perfect for those who are beginners or who have basic knowledge of French.  I explain a few things in English just for basic understanding but we'll speak a lot of French and you'll start seeing results in very little time.  I send preparation materials before the lesson (video presentation, pdfs, online exercises, and podcast episode all made by me) so that we will spend the lesson practicing, experimenting, and speaking rather than just presenting information. This will save you time and money and it will make the lesson much more enjoyable.  Learn more in 3 months that you would in 3 years!

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner/Elementary Spanish (A1-A2): Quick, Easy, and Fun
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Aprende español hoy mismo! Learn Spanish today!
Amazing course that will get you speaking Spanish super quick! I'll send preparation materials beforehand (video presentations, pdfs, exercises, and podcasts all made by me ) and we will spend the lesson experimenting, practicing, and speaking! I'll use a bit of English just to explain some of the grammar but I try to use as much natural Spanish as possible. The lessons are communicative, fun, and interactive.  I have the formula to get my students to speak basic Spanish in very little time. Learn in 3 months what you would normally learn in 3 years!
